customer_name: IBM Office of Privacy and Responsible Technology
business_problem: IBM needed a scalable way to govern privacy and AI compliance across thousands of applications, global entities and emerging regulations without relying on regionalized, manually maintained programs.
solution_summary: IBM created the Privacy and AI Management System (PIMS) as a centralized governance platform built around IBM OpenPages, IBM Knowledge Catalog, IBM Cloud Pak for Data AI Factsheets and, over time, IBM watsonx.governance. OpenPages provides the workflow backbone for governance, risk and compliance activity, while Knowledge Catalog maintains the related data assets and relationships that make privacy and AI information traceable. AI Factsheets in Cloud Pak for Data track machine-learning models from training through production, capturing the metrics and lifecycle evidence needed for monitoring quality, fairness and drift. Regulations and remediation requirements can then be imported into the governance model so PIMS can register algorithmic systems, assess risks, launch compliance campaigns and route follow-up tasks through a single enterprise process. The architecture effectively treats governance as a continuously updated data platform, letting IBM move from ad hoc regional programs to always-on AI and privacy oversight at global scale.

solution_components.name: IBM OpenPages
solution_components.role: Provides the automated workflow and centralized control plane for privacy, AI and GRC processes inside PIMS.

solution_components.name: IBM Knowledge Catalog
solution_components.role: Stores and curates the governance data, metadata and knowledge assets used by PIMS.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Supplies AI Factsheets that track models from training to production and capture risk-monitoring evidence.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Represents the next-generation governance layer IBM plans to use for broader model lifecycle and benchmarking capabilities.

data_flow: Privacy metadata, AI lifecycle records, regulatory requirements and remediation tasks are captured in OpenPages and Knowledge Catalog, model evidence is tracked through AI Factsheets, and dashboards surface the resulting compliance status and actions across IBM's global operations.
business_outcome: PIMS lets IBM launch compliance programs much faster, manage AI and privacy obligations at enterprise scale and reduce manual remediation work while improving auditability and trust around algorithmic systems.
